values.note: Padded full-hookup sites 1-13 $25; electric overflow sites 32-41 $15; rustic sites 14-17 $15 and tent sites 18-20 $10. An additional tent is $10 a night. Filling a tank at the spigot is $10; the dump station is free to registered campers. Refunds only if requested 2 weeks before the date, less a 25% fee.

fees.source: https://secure.rec1.com/WI/city-antigo-parks-recreation/catalog/index?filter=dGFiJTVCNDI1JTVEPTEmc2VhcmNoPQ== ('Padded RV sites (1-13) ... $25/night'; 'Overflow RV sites (33-41) accommodate RVs up to 45' ... have 50 amp & 30 amp electric: $15/night'; 'Additional Tent ... $10/night'; 'Water: You may fill your camper on site ... $10/fill'; 'The Dump Station is free for registered campers'; 'Campsite fees are non-refundable unless requested 2 weeks prior ... 25% administrative processing fee'), read 2026-11-16

hookups.source: https://secure.rec1.com/WI/city-antigo-parks-recreation/catalog/index?filter=dGFiJTVCNDI1JTVEPTEmc2VhcmNoPQ== ('Padded RV sites (1-13) accommodate RVs up to 45' in length, have 50 amp & 30 amp electric, and water/sewer'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: Sites 1-13 are paved full-hookup pads and 32-41 electric-only overflow sites (32 takes rigs up to 25 ft). Rustic sites 14-17 take a camper up to 22 ft or a tent (15-amp outlets that won't power a camper); 18-20 are tent only.

sites.source: https://secure.rec1.com/WI/city-antigo-parks-recreation/catalog/index?filter=dGFiJTVCNDI1JTVEPTEmc2VhcmNoPQ== (site list; 30 Lake Park items in the catalog); 2022 campground map (RV 1-13, 14-20, RV 32-41), read 2026-11-16

facilities.source: https://secure.rec1.com/WI/city-antigo-parks-recreation/catalog/index?filter=dGFiJTVCNDI1JTVEPTEmc2VhcmNoPQ== ('All sites/campers have access to the shower/restroom facility'; 'Dump Station'; 'Wifi is available'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: City of Antigo's Rec1 catalog; full payment is due within 5 business days of booking. An unreserved site is claimed by setting up a camper or tent on it. Rustic sites 14-20 allow at most a week per visit and two weeks a season.

booking.source: https://secure.rec1.com/WI/city-antigo-parks-recreation/catalog/index?filter=dGFiJTVCNDI1JTVEPTEmc2VhcmNoPQ== ('Reservations will be accepted for all sites beginning one year out from the requested date and require full payment within 5 business days'; 'All sites that have not been reserved are on a first-come, first-served basis'; 'Rustic camping sites (14-20) are allowed stays no more than 1 week'), read 2026-11-16

note: City of Antigo Parks & Recreation campground at Lake Park, 815 Hudson St., within walking distance of downtown, four ball diamonds, the Springbrook Trail and a disc golf course. --Claude
summary: City page + Rec1 catalog read: 30 sites (13 FHU 50A $25, 10 electric overflow $15, 7 rustic/tent), 45-ft max, showers, dump, Wi-Fi, season May 1-Oct 1, reservations 1 year out on Rec1, unreserved sites FCFS. Fees were missing, now $15-25. Not waterfront kept. Google 4.4 (66).
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept - the park sits between a school, ball fields and houses; the nearest water is a marshy pond ~150 m north-east behind a row of houses.
PIN: stored 45.1439,-89.1461 is the Hudson St. entrance by the full-hookup row; the sites centre ~45.1437,-89.1452 (~80 m). Fine.
